description: Exeevo is a global cloud solutions provider for life sciences companies to improve how they interact with customers across their organization to provide exceptional experiences that drive commercial objectives and improve patients’ lives.

The Medscape Professional Network is the #1 network of websites for physicians worldwide for the fourth consecutive year*, providing over 5 million physicians and 11 million healthcare professionals with the latest medical news and expert perspectives; essential point-of-care drug and disease information; and relevant professional education and CME. Our mission is to improve patient care with comprehensive clinical information and resources essential to physicians and healthcare professionals.

Together, advancing the business of science. Across life sciences you’ll find innovators who are developing therapies, treatments, devices, and cures to meet society’s most pressing health challenges and deliver wellness for all. Alongside them, you’ll find our leaders, the professionals of Deloitte’s Life Sciences practice, who are orchestrating and delivering the business of science and health. We help drive impact through deep industry experience and insights; transformative strategies; trusted, flexible approaches; and new technologies. We help accelerate action and create connections that empower a digitally enabled, equitable future of health.

Our unified platform is tailor-made for life sciences organizations with streamlined processes for patient services, stakeholder engagement, commercial operations, and advanced therapy coordination. Powered by Agentforce, our single, connected platform brings together the full power of CRM, AI, and Data to help MedTech and Pharma organizations to offer their products more broadly and connect patients to life-enhancing therapies and devices faster.

Doceree is the only AI-powered Operating System for healthcare marketing. We believe the role of AI is to bring richer context to every HCP interaction. Hence, our patented AI understands multiple layers of context to enhance every HCP interaction in a privacy-compliant manner, delivering measurably better outcomes every time. In just five years, we have emerged as leaders in AI-powered, hyper-personalized healthcare messaging — redefining HCP engagement with more powerful context and more powerful outcomes.

Valantic is a leading digital solutions, consulting, and software company that enables organizations to successfully navigate digital transformation by combining technological expertise with industry knowledge. We help clients turn strategy into measurable results and stay ahead in the digital age.

EVERSANA INTOUCH is the AI-powered agency redefining life sciences commercialization. Embedded within EVERSANA’s end-to-end commercialization platform, we replace fragmented agency models with a single operating system that connects strategy, execution, and data. Our AI-orchestrated experiences drive faster adoption, smarter decisions, and measurable impact across the full commercialization lifecycle.

Axtria helps life sciences companies harness the potential of data science and software to improve patient outcomes by connecting the right therapies to the right patients at the right time. The company is a leading global provider of award-winning cloud software and data analytics to the life sciences industry. We’re proud to deliver proven solutions that help pharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostics companies complete their journey from data to insights to action, enabling them to earn superior returns on their investments.
Cheemia is an innovative and independent healthcare company based in Edinburgh, specialising in market access and pull-through for small but growing pharmaceutical companies.

Ingemark is a technology company specializing in AI-driven solutions, with AssistCraft Suite as its flagship product. AssistCraft is an enterprise-grade AI multi-agent platform that enhances business operations by integrating seamlessly with company data and IT ecosystems. It offers multimodal AI chat capabilities, real-time data access, and regulatory compliance. With deep expertise in AI customization in the MedTech industry, Ingemark empowers global organizations to deploy scalable, secure, and intelligent AI assistants that optimize workflows and decision-making.

Media-Soft CRM delivers power, flexibility, and intelligence to the pharmaceutical industry. Our AI-driven solution enables companies of all sizes to strengthen relationships with HCPs and stakeholders, empowering sales teams and Key Account Managers to perform at their best. We focus on innovation and efficiency, providing tools that drive smarter decisions, accelerate growth, and build lasting connections.

At AITHENA, we want to eliminate the friction and complexities of the Medical, Legal & Regulatory (MLR) review process in the pharmaceutical industry, empowering medical affairs and marketing professionals to focus on their core strengths—enhancing patient care and driving innovation.

OxfordSM is a strategy, planning, change management, and capability consultancy that partners with organisations to help them grow sustainably. Specialising in the life sciences and consumer goods sectors, they work on aligning strategy, business planning, and execution to deliver impactful change. They emphasise clarity, simplicity, and interdependence, ensuring that transformations stick and benefit people, the planet, and profit. With a 35-year history, OxfordSM is known for its long-term client relationships and personalised, senior-level consulting expertise, working as an extension of their clients' teams.

CMI Media Group is a global full-service media agency focused solely on health, wellness, and pharmaceutical marketing. CMI Media Group is WPP’s healthcare-only media agency, with core offerings including Audience Strategy, Planning, Development, and Insights; Data and Analytics; Buying and Investment; and Direct Response and Customer Experience. As the leading media resource for the world’s top healthcare companies, CMI Media Group brings together leading technology, data, and talent to deliver seamless capabilities for clients. CMI Media Group has been recognized as a leader in DE&I, talent retention and employee development as well as one of the industry’s best places to work.

Vertical Search - Targeting & Segmentation more effective than ever before. AI-powered search engine for the healthcare market Are you looking for the right contacts in the market? Do you want to bring new treatments, drugs for rare diseases or medical devices to the doctors who are actively involved in your field? Then we have just the thing for you! Because there are no limits for our customizable search engine, no matter if pharma, medtech, digitalization or an unprecedented market transparency - everything is possible through our Vertical Search Health.

Viseven is a future-inspired global MarTech Services Provider for Pharma and Life Sciences industries with more than a decade of experience. Viseven offers innovative solutions for companies of different sizes and digital maturity levels by merging marketing and digital technology expertise with innovation and strategic capabilities. The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the TOP 100 Pharma and Life Sciences companies in more than 50 countries around the globe.

Our mission is clear: we transform knowledge into actionable intelligence, helping researchers, educators, and professionals tackle today's most pressing challenges. We publish trusted research that empowers groundbreaking scientific advances, supports the next generation of learners and professionals, and builds the bridge from knowledge to impact.

G-Med is the world’s largest global physician-only community, reaching over 1.5 million verified physicians across 100+ specialties in more than 160 countries. Our medical crowdsourcing platform empowers physicians worldwide to discuss real-world medicine, collaborate on complex clinical cases, and participate in paid surveys and market research. Every day, G-Med members engage with local and global Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), join educational activities, and consult with peers to solve clinical dilemmas- improving diagnostic accuracy and accelerating patient care. By harnessing the collective intelligence of the global medical community, G-Med helps physicians shorten time to diagnosis and improve healthcare outcomes.

Clarivate is a leading global provider of transformative intelligence. We offer enriched data, insights & analytics, workflow solutions and expert services in the areas of Academia & Government, Intellectual Property and Life Sciences & Healthcare. Clarivate has a growing global Commercial Consulting team with a commitment to partnering with life sciences and pharma leaders in advancing innovation, maximising asset value and enabling improved outcomes for patients in need across the world. These service offerings encompass integrated patient journey, brand launch strategy, customer engagement and go-to-market model, customer segmentation and profiling, omnichannel and digital engagement, and point-of-care digital messaging

Resonant Group is an award-winning group of agencies driven by the same core values and a common belief that lives can be transformed through better health communication. Resonant Group companies, Anthem, Bedrock, and Origins, provide strategic and operational support for medical communication, healthcare communications and patient engagement.

Bepossible helps pharma leaders make the right strategic and tactical choices - and activate them in the real world. What makes us different is our combination of deep pharma leadership experience and the science of behavioural change. We design strategy with human behaviour in mind from day one - so it actually sticks and unlocks performance.

Sorcero's medical AI platform transforms life sciences decision-making, accelerating patient access to life-saving treatments. By harnessing insights from global medical data, we empower industry leaders to deliver breakthrough therapies. Founded in 2018 by pioneers in AI, public health, and personalized content, Sorcero is a Certified B Corp headquartered in Washington, DC. Our innovation has been recognized by over a dozen awards, including Fast Company's Most Innovative companies of 2024, and six foundational medical AI patents.

Semalytix is the world's largest & only GDPR-compliant Patient Experience dataset covering 30+ indications and is tailored for Medical Affairs & Commercial use cases. Combined with our proprietary AI, PatientGPT delivers Qual. & Quant. insights within 30 seconds for your target patient population based on real patient experiences.

PharmaForceIQ is a real-time engagement platform built specifically for life sciences, giving you an unfair advantage in reaching and engaging customers. Our platform unites deep affinity data for 7M+ HCPs, signals from dozens of real-world data sources, streamlined optichannel execution across 25K+ sites/platforms, and live Rx-level reporting to understand ROI. With dynamic targeting and deployment, you never miss a moment that matters. Experience the power of true agility: launch on the optimal mix for your audience, optimize campaigns mid-flight, sync with the field effectively, and prove impact fast. This drives such meaningful impact that we’ve earned a 100% client renewal rate. We’re more than a vendor—we’re a dedicated partner who shows up with strategy, speed, and transparency. By focusing on one product per indication, we offer true exclusivity and alignment.

Endava partners with healthcare and life sciences organisations to unlock measurable value from digital investment, helping leading pharma, medtech, and life sciences businesses improve R&D productivity, accelerate clinical development, strengthen commercial performance, and optimise access, outcomes, and operations. Through data, AI, cloud, platform engineering, automation, product development, and experience design, we modernise critical workflows and build scalable digital foundations that deliver lasting impact across complex, regulated environments.

Cvent is a leader in event and marketing technology, helping life sciences and healthcare organisations deliver compliant, insight‑rich in‑person, hybrid and virtual meetings, webinars, and HCP engagement programs worldwide. Our platform manages registration, content, travel, spend and approvals while supporting complex regulatory, data‑privacy and HCP‑spend requirements. Trusted by 25 of the top 25 pharma companies, Cvent has powered millions of events since 1999 and integrates with key CRM and compliance systems to provide accurate, audit‑ready data. We help commercial, medical, and marketing teams turn events into a measurable growth channel across the product lifecycle and deepen HCP and stakeholder relationships.

CMG.Digital is a digital scale agency and for over 20 years we have been delivering global multi-language assets while generating savings of up to 60% in time and 30% in costs for the world's leading brands. Specializing in end-to-end solutions, from digital asset adaptations through the Global to Local approach to complex transformations, our expertise spans across website and app development, SEO, graphic design, video editing, 3D modeling, transcreation, translation, UX/UI design, art direction, copywriting and much more. Committed to accessibility standards and sustainability principles, we ensure our services align with the highest industry standards.

With more than 25 years of experience in the pharmaceutical and Life Sciences sector, Seprotec helps global brands create multilingual marketing and digital content that is persuasive, meaningful, and engaging across markets. We combine advanced AI language technology with Life Sciences expertise, experienced linguists, and deep knowledge of IP management to support global campaigns, product and brand websites, patents, trademarks, and more.

ITSM CENTER d.o.o. is a company from Slovenia, focusing on IT Service Management (ITSM), Project Management, Information Security Management, GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) and Digital transformation to ensure our clients reach their strategic goals in effective and efficient manner. We work in more than 20 different countries across the globe having worked with more than 200 companies from different industries. Our global customer base is quite diverse and vast. To give you an idea of application areas for which we have successfully delivered our consulting or training services, here are some main industry segments we can identify: - Information Technology Industry - Financial Industry - Pharmaceutical industry - Telecom industry - Insurance industry - Public Administration - Food Industry

Buzz Radar has been at the cutting edge of social and audience intelligence for the past 13 years, with the last 6 years focused on navigating the complex healthcare and pharmaceutical landscape. We understand that successful pharmaceutical insight and content creation requires the right combination of people, processes, and technology - a critical balance often overlooked in this highly regulated industry. Even substantial investments in advanced listening platforms yield limited value without a team that truly understands the unique challenges of pharmaceutical customer, competitor, and content intelligence. It’s comparable to acquiring sophisticated diagnostic equipment without specialists who know how to interpret the results - a costly investment sitting idle while critical decisions remain unmade. That’s why we’ve assembled a team of healthcare-focused analysts, strategists, and compliance experts who leverage Buzz Radar’s AI-powered platform specifically for life sciences. This deep industry experience led us, over the past 18 months, to develop BRIANN, an intelligent life sciences partner that combines our healthcare expertise with cutting-edge, easy-to-use AI. Our team immerse themselves in your therapeutic areas and objectives, using BRIANN to deliver actionable insights that meet the stringent requirements of the pharmaceutical world.

KAI: Elevating Every Life Sciences Conversation. KAI is the leading AI platform designed to accelerate field performance at scale. By combining real-time personalized nudges with our industry-first NetKonnector Score, we help Pharma brands measure—and immediately improve—the quality of HCP interactions. Predict: Use NKS as a leading indicator of behavior change & Revenue. Empower: Deliver real-time personalized coaching to Commercial and Medical teams. Insight: Capture deep clinical and brand intelligence globally. Want to know your score? Visit us at the stand.

Visual Pharma by Powtoon is a pharma-safe AI platform that transforms complex science into clear, compliant visual communication - fast. At its core is MOA Studio, enabling teams to create medically accurate Mechanism of Action videos that clarify complex pathways and align scientific understanding across stakeholders. Built for Medical Affairs and cross-functional teams, it supports rapid creation of videos and presentations from approved content, with governance, audit trails, and compliance built in. The result: faster content creation, reduced agency dependency, and scalable, in-house scientific communication that evolves with new evidence.

Onomi is a platform that helps pharma instrument scientific exchanges at congresses, webinars and advisory boards - connecting KOL engagement, booth insights, and symposium data into a single evidence layer integrated with your CRM. With over 22 years of experience & trusted by 15 of the top 20 life science companies, Onomi creates engaging HCP experiences, measures real impact & is more cost-effective than traditional point solutions.

When it comes to harnessing the power of GenAI – it's the quality of your inputs that matter the most. Meet Rumi, the expert digital facilitator with a human-centred core designed to amplify meaningful stakeholder contributions across the spectrum of online activities (from advisory boards to document co-creation). Rumi welcomes your experts into intuitive and interactive 'rooms' where they're encouraged to ruminate and engage more thoroughly, revealing higher quality insights, with less effort. Avoid GenAI “GIGO”, book a demo with Rumi - and unlock the best minds globally.

SciencePOD is specialises in creating digital content specifically designed to engage HCPs. We deliver clear, concise and compelling summarised highlights of medical and scientific content in text, infographic, podcast, video and AI-summary formats. Our content creation platform hosts a global community of over 600 medical and science writing professionals.

PM360 embraces diversity, gender equality, ideas, and innovation that advance bold ideas in pharmaceutical marketing. PM360 is the premier magazine for marketing decision-makers in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries. Published monthly, PM360 is the only journal that focuses on delivering the full spectrum of practical information necessary for product managers and pharma marketing professionals to succeed in the complex healthcare environment.

My Medical Affairs (MyMA)provides you with one central place to keep up to date with all the upcoming events relevant to your medical affairs interests, from a plethora of organizations around the globe. Additionally, you can access on-demand content. MyMA curates the content relevant to your individual preferences, or you can search for events/content by keyword, topic, organization or author. Monthly email notifications will keep you on top of everything happening that month, and there is also a solution provider directory.

TrendMD is the leading content discovery network in healthcare, driving HCP engagement through trusted partnerships with more than 9,000 medical and healthcare websites, including top publishers such as BMJ, JAMA, Elsevier, and The Lancet. Each month we reach over five million healthcare professionals worldwide, including 85% of US HCPs, by delivering scientific content directly within the environments where clinicians stay informed and make decisions. We have partnered with more than 55 leading pharmaceutical companies and medical communications teams to amplify CME, guidelines, and clinical research at scale. With targeting by specialty, geography, or custom prescriber lists, TrendMD ensures content reaches the most relevant audiences. Its plug-and-play model makes it easy to incorporate into any omnichannel strategy, helping teams extend visibility and measurable engagement globally.

PharmaShots is a fast-growing life sciences media and insights platform, established in 2018 to serve the evolving needs of the biopharma and healthcare industries. Originally launched as a news blog, it has expanded into a full-service provider offering concise news summaries, strategic branding, content creation, digital marketing, distribution, and customized intelligence reports. Catering to stakeholders across pharma, biotech, medtech, diagnostics, and digital health, PharmaShots empowers decision-makers with timely, actionable insights. With a subscriber base of over 20,000, the platform bridges the gap between healthcare brands and key decision-makers through innovative, impact-driven media solutions that support strategic growth and informed decision-making.

World Pharma Today is one of the best online service providers to the Pharma Community. It is a complete Pharma business to business portal which facilitates Pharma traders, Pharma manufacturers, Pharma sellers, Pharma suppliers in improving their business relationships.

With a presence in more than 80 locations worldwide, the HBA partners with nearly 150 organizations and reaches nearly six million professionals through its Corporate Partner ecosystem spanning biotech, pharmaceuticals, providers, payers, and technology. From the bench to the bedside, workforce demand for HBA membership, engagement, experiences, and market presence continues to grow across domestic and global markets.

Engineered for Impact.

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. With our hybrid working policies, wellness initiatives, growth opportunities, and benefits designed to make life healthier, we give our team the ability to shine.

AI-based solution for perfect HCP & Customer journeys.
